senses.gloss: ? abhrati (Skt. Dhātup. only, with artificial occurrences in Bhaṭṭikāvya; Pali abbhati, also only Gr.), goes: perhaps read (a)bhritvā, or MIndic (a)bbhitvā, ger., [] having gone, Mv 〔i.187.7〕 (vs; after final -o, -ā, or -e); mss. bhyatvā or bhyotvā (one tyotvā, one datvā); Senart em. bhūtvā, which I think is clearly wrong; a verb of motion seems required.
